It feeds on tiny cave organisms that are themselves bioluminescent, and on full nights the entire cave pool where Sparkub sleeps glows faintly gold.
stages.note: The golden orb above Sparkub's head bobs up when it is curious and droops flat to its head when it is frightened.

stages.name: Voltubby
stages.bio: Voltubby has inflated considerably - its body now bristles with short sharp spines that each carry a small charge of electric-laced venom. Its coloring has shifted to deep purple-blue with a glowing aura of purple haze that hangs around it like a permanent cloud. It navigates Storm Spire' flooded passages by bouncing its electric pulse off the walls like sonar, mapping the tunnels as it moves. When startled, it inflates instantly to twice its resting size and every spine lights up with purple electric sparks.
stages.note: Voltubby can inflate to twice its size in under half a second - cave explorers listen for the sharp pop of its spine-lock as a warning.

stages.name: Thunderspike
stages.bio: Thunderspike is a sphere of dense shadow and crackling electricity - its body has grown into a permanently inflated ball covered in long radiating spines that each end in a bright charged tip. The dark spaces between its spines seem deeper than the cave walls around it, as if the shadow there is not ordinary. It moves through Storm Spire' deepest flooded chambers slowly and deliberately, for nothing else will approach it. The old cave-keepers say Thunderspike does not hunt - it simply waits, and the cave's currents bring everything it needs.
stages.note: The water within a meter of Thunderspike carries a mild electrical charge strong enough to make small fish lose coordination - it never has to chase.

stages.name: Sparkusk
stages.bio: Sparkusk is a dark-furred pup bristling with energy - its fur stands in spiky tufts all over, and bold yellow lightning bolt markings streak its sides and haunches. Its sharp eyes dart between shadows constantly, and it instinctively circles any new object three times before approaching it. In Storm Spire, Sparkusk pups can be found in small clusters at the boundaries between the Hollow's inner dark and the faint light of the surrounding forest, neither fully in nor fully out - curious about both, committed to neither.
stages.note: Sparkusk circles any new object exactly three times before deciding whether to approach or retreat - it has never been observed skipping this ritual.

stages.name: Thunderusk
stages.bio: Thunderusk has grown into a lean and powerful four-legged creature with vivid yellow lightning-bolt body markings that glow faintly even in daylight. Its dark fur has tightened against its frame, and its silhouette moving through the Storm Spire trees is more lightning-shape than animal-shape. It runs without sound until it chooses to - the spire goes perfectly silent for three beats before Thunderusk passes, and loud again three beats after. Old Storm Spire stories say that if you hear that silence, you are about to be tested on something you thought you had forgotten.
stages.note: Storm Spire goes silent for exactly three seconds before Thunderusk passes through any given point on its route.

stages.name: Voltexar
stages.bio: Voltexar's body is a map of lightning - bold yellow bolts cover its dark coat from muzzle to tail in patterns that shift slightly each time it sheds, as if the electricity itself is redrawing its own signature. It stands with a weight and stillness that makes the ground feel different beneath its paws. When it discharges a full bolt it disappears entirely in the flash and reappears three body-lengths ahead - a blink-step that Storm Spire explorers insist must be cheating. The guardians recorded it as the Hollow's Arbiter: the creature that decides who may leave.
stages.note: Voltexar's lightning-bolt markings shift slightly every six months as it sheds - each new pattern is different from any that came before.

stages.name: Sparkbug
stages.bio: This Sparkbug wears a dark rounded shell and stands out in Storm Spire by the single vivid blue crystal spike that rises from its head like a tiny beacon. The crystal glows faintly and pulses with each step it takes, as though counting. It rolls beetle-style through the dense undergrowth of Storm Spire, following the underground water channels by the faint electrical resonance they carry. Young ones are found near the spire's crystal-veined stones, tapping their crystal horn against the rock to hear it ring - a sound they seem to find deeply satisfying.
stages.note: Sparkbug taps its crystal horn against rocks to test their mineral content - it eats only the rocks that ring in a specific tone.

stages.name: Voltusker
stages.bio: Voltusker has grown into a formidable dark-blue rhinoceros beetle with a thick curved horn that now crackles with active electricity, and heavy plate armor across its back and shoulders. Lightning arcs between its horn and the ground with every few steps, scoring tiny black marks in the soil. When it lowers its head and charges, the horn focuses the electric discharge into a point - and nothing in Storm Spire's undergrowth stays in that line. It defends its stretch of the spire with absolute conviction, and the other bugs give it wide berth.
stages.note: Voltusker leaves a trail of regularly spaced lightning marks in the soil wherever it walks - Storm Spire trackers can identify it at a glance.

stages.name: Voltumoth
stages.bio: Voltumoth has gained broad luminous wings marked with golden lightning patterns on jet-black membranes - a transformation that stuns even those who watched the whole process. Its heavy armored body has become slightly lighter at the thorax to allow flight, but it still carries the full weight of a rhinoceros beetle in its plated limbs and fists. In Storm Spire it is the rarest sight: it flies only at night, and only when the lightning season peaks. Each wingbeat charges the air with the smell of thunderstorms, and the spire's crops grow measurably faster beneath its flight path.
stages.note: The soil in Storm Spire directly beneath Voltumoth's flight path is measurably richer in nitrogen for three days after it passes over.

stages.name: Voxlet
stages.bio: Voxlet is a small round-faced purple bat with large round ears, simple leathery wings, and a nose that twitches constantly at air currents too faint for other creatures to detect. It navigates Ghost Hollow by wind-taste alone - it knows the direction of every draft in the hollow, and drafts that carry spoken words are its favorite, carrying a sweet resonance it follows like a scent trail. It hangs in clusters with other Voxlets, and the air between them is always slightly cooler, as if their presence draws warmth from the world and replaces it with quietness.
stages.note: A cluster of Voxlets sharing a roost makes the surrounding air measurably cooler - Ghost Hollow villagers use them as natural air conditioners.

stages.name: Voxian
stages.bio: Voxian has grown into a standing figure - upright on two clawed legs, with long elongated arms that end in wing membranes that fold and flare with expressive precision. Its purple-dark body is lean and angular, and its clawed wing-joints can grip surfaces that give it a disturbing stillness when perched on the side of a tree. It hunts by listening to the voices on the wind from great height, then diving without sound into the source of the voice it chose. In Ghost Hollow it is the voice-finder - it brings back echoes of words that were spoken too quietly to hear the first time.
stages.note: Voxian dives toward any voice it finds interesting - finding one perched behind you in Ghost Hollow means you just said a word it had not heard before.

stages.name: Voxalith
stages.bio: Voxalith is a massive dark dragon-bat hybrid with horns curving back from its broad head, enormous wings mapped with purple-gold vein patterns, and a body armored in overlapping dark scales. When it spreads its wings in Ghost Hollow the air displacement is equivalent to a gale - trees bend, leaves scatter, and any sound in the hollow is carried away instantly. It is the Hollow's wind itself, some say - not a creature that lives in the wind but the embodiment of it, carrying every voice that was ever raised in Ghost Hollow on those vast dark wings.
stages.note: When Voxalith spreads its wings fully, every sound in the surrounding kilometer is erased for three full seconds - the hollow goes absolutely silent.

stages.name: Zephchick
stages.bio: Zephchick is a dainty pale-blue dove with soft round wings and a golden halo hovering above its head - not a decoration but a real electric corona that sparks when it hears thunder. It perches on the highest Storm Spire outcroppings, eyes wide, tracking every lightning bolt to map the paths it wants to fly someday. It chirps a quick two-note call before each flight as if asking permission from the sky, and waits for the answering rumble before it dares to lift off.
stages.note: Zephchick's halo pulses once per second in calm weather but triples in speed just before a storm - eleven minutes before the first lightning strike.

stages.name: Zephawk
stages.bio: Zephawk is now a fierce silver-and-white eagle, chest thrust forward, wings spread wide and crackling with blue lightning arcs along each primary feather. Its talons grip the highest Storm Spire crags, and yellow eyes survey the gale with a warrior's attention. It dives at storm-speeds - reaching terminal velocity in four wing-beats - and the lightning it trails marks temporary bright paths through the cloud that other creatures follow for hours after it has gone.
stages.note: The lightning trails Zephawk leaves during a dive form a different ancient sigil every time - no trail has ever repeated.

stages.name: Zephyrian
stages.bio: Zephyrian is a magnificent thunder-eagle: its great white-and-blue body crackles with electric coronae along every wing edge, and its ice-blue eyes carry the calm authority of a creature that has weathered every storm the Spire has produced. It spreads its wings and the air itself charges - hair stands up, lightning finds new paths, and every creature nearby suddenly remembers a word they thought they had forgotten. At the Storm Spire summit it is both sentinel and teacher.
stages.note: Zephyrian has circled the Storm Spire without landing for recorded periods of up to forty-three days - researchers call it the Eternal Loop.

stages.name: Zephkit
stages.bio: Zephkit is a small, fluffy sky-blue husky pup with a spiral swirl pattern on its flank and bright pale eyes full of cheerful recklessness. Its tail curls up and wags constantly, and small static sparks fly off its fur when it shakes dry. At the base of the Storm Spire it races the lower wind-gusts, falling over its own paws, then immediately racing again. When it howls, the sound carries much farther than a pup its size should produce - a fact that delights it.
stages.note: Zephkit howls in a specific direction before every storm, and that direction has never pointed the wrong way in recorded history.

stages.name: Zephound
stages.bio: Zephound is a lean electric wolf, its white-blue coat charged with crackling blue energy, a single spiraled horn rising from its brow that catches and focuses wind into a directed beam. Its howl at full stride has been clocked at three times the audible range for its size, and it leaves a faint ozone trail that lingers for twenty minutes. It races the lightning around the Storm Spire, tracking the paths Jack once walked, howling the guardian's name into every gale it passes through.
stages.note: Zephound's horn acts as a lightning rod exactly once per storm - at the precise moment the storm peaks - and it always survives.

stages.name: Tempestyx
stages.bio: Tempestyx is a glacier-wolf of immense presence: thick icy-blue fur erupts in a mane of frozen crystal spines around its shoulders and haunches, and the air within five meters crackles and swirls in a permanent micro-storm of its making. It howls at the very summit of the Storm Spire where Jack was taken into the gale, and the thunder answers - not as coincidence but as confirmation. Every climber who reaches the top and speaks the right word finds Tempestyx waiting, ready to carry them through the deepest cloud.
stages.note: The eye of every Storm Spire tempest is always positioned directly above wherever Tempestyx is standing - meteorologists have checked eighteen storms.

stages.name: Zyphule
stages.bio: Zyphule is a lime-green slug with two antenna-stalks topped by round green bulbs, and a vivid purple mantle of slime trailing behind it. Bright green droplets ooze from its back and glow faintly in shadow, marking a trail anyone could follow through Verdant Valley's undergrowth. It moves very slowly, tasting everything it passes with its whole body, and pauses to touch each hand-carved stone in the valley floor with its antenna before moving on.
stages.note: Zyphule's trail glows for exactly ninety minutes before fading - trackers in Verdant Valley use old trails to map where new creatures recently passed.

stages.name: Zyphant
stages.bio: Zyphant has grown a row of green bubble-nodes along its back that it inflates when nervous - each one pops with a faint acid-spray if touched. Its purple underside now carries faint stripes, and it travels faster, leaving twin slime-rails through the Verdant Valley leaf litter. A child who visits it regularly discovers it begins to recognize their footsteps and moves slightly toward them, which no one expected from something this slimy.
stages.note: The bubble-nodes on Zyphant's back pop in a specific sequence when startled - researchers have found the sequence spells 'wait' in old insect-sign.

stages.name: Zyphemoth
stages.bio: Zyphemoth is a great mound of toxic green-and-purple armor, its body studded with dozens of poison-dripping spines that make it look like a living cactus made of acid. Beneath the spines a powerful body moves with surprising purpose, and its two antenna-stalks have grown into sharp sensory horns that can taste the air for words a full kilometer away. In Verdant Valley it is the last guardian of the song-grove's roots - and nothing with bad intent has ever reached those roots while Zyphemoth was present.
stages.note: The spines on Zyphemoth regrow after being shed, and each regrown spine is slightly more potent than the last - it has been growing since the valley's first naming.

stages.name: Thornel
stages.bio: Thornel is a small, bright green pup made of living grass and curling vines, with a few orange thorns on its back and a curly vine tail. It hides in the tall grass of the Dark Forest and watches travelers with big dark eyes before deciding whether to play or run away. Younger forest creatures follow it everywhere, and it guards them bravely.
stages.note: The swirling vines on Thornel's body grow a little longer every time it protects a friend.

stages.name: Thornfang
stages.bio: Thornfang has grown into a slim, clever fox. Its tall pointed ears have purple insides, a black mask surrounds its glowing amber eyes, and its body is half green leaves, half dark fur. Green vines wrap its black legs, sharp thorns curve back from its shoulders, and its huge tail is made of twisted thorny vines. It moves through the thickets without a sound and always knows the hidden path.
stages.note: Thornfang sleeps curled inside its own tail, and the thorns keep it safe all night.

stages.name: Thornmaul
stages.bio: Thornmaul is a huge thorn wolf that guards the darkest groves of the Dark Forest. Its dark purple body is made of roots and bark wrapped in green vines, a wild mane of leaves and giant thorns covers its neck and shoulders, and its purple eyes glow in the shadows. When it roars, the whole forest goes quiet. It is fierce, but only to those who try to harm the forest.
stages.note: The darker the forest grows around Thornmaul, the brighter its eyes shine.

stages.name: Rimepup
stages.bio: Rimepup is a stocky white-furred wolf pup with frost crystals permanently rimed along its paws and jaw, and a habit of headbutting anything that moves - including rocks, and occasionally itself. It tumbles through the Frozen Peaks' lower drifts practicing pounces on nothing in particular, building the strength that will define it later. It is stubborn, warm-hearted, and utterly undeterred by falling down.
stages.note: Rimepup's frost-rimed paws never actually feel cold to the touch - the ice is decorative, not thermal, according to guardian researchers.

stages.name: Frostknuckle
stages.bio: Frostknuckle has become a broad, powerfully built wolf with ice-hardened knuckle-plates along its front paws that it uses to strike stone as easily as flesh. It spars against the Frozen Peaks' ice formations for hours at a stretch, and climbers have learned to follow the sound of its training as a rough trail-marker toward safer ground. It respects strength but reserves genuine warmth for whoever keeps training after they've lost.
stages.note: Frostknuckle's ice-knuckle plates re-form within minutes if chipped in sparring - a self-repairing trait unique to this evolution stage.

stages.name: Glacierbrawler
stages.bio: Glacierbrawler is a massive ice-armored wolf whose entire forequarters are sheathed in glacier-blue plating, capable of cracking exposed stone with a single forepaw strike. It holds the highest, coldest reaches of the Frozen Peaks as its own proving ground, and guardian texts call it the peak's oldest standing challenge - a test that has never once needed to be repeated for anyone who genuinely earned its respect.
stages.note: Glacierbrawler's strikes have been measured cracking stone at a force no other creature of its size in the Peaks can match.

stages.name: Luxpaw
stages.bio: Luxpaw is a bright orange dragon pup with a crest of black horns and a soft cream ruff. It loves to practice little punches in the morning sun, and its fists glow faintly when it gets excited.

stages.name: Lumiclaw
stages.bio: Lumiclaw has grown tall and quick, with wide orange wings and dark claws. It trains from sunrise to sunset, and the black horn on its head has started to grow into the shape of a helmet.

stages.name: Luxstrike
stages.bio: Luxstrike is a proud light warrior. A black thorn spear grows from one arm and a horn shield from the other, both edged with golden light, and black scales guard its chest like armor. It fights only to protect its friends.

stages.name: Emberkin
stages.bio: Emberkin is a small orange dragon with glowing lava lines and a crest of short brown-grey horns. It has no wings yet, but it is brave, stubborn and always ready for a friendly fight.

stages.name: Magmaw
stages.bio: Magmaw has grown strong and heavy, with lava glowing between its scales. When it roars, the ground near it grows warm.

stages.name: Pyrovant
stages.bio: Pyrovant is a mighty lava dragon. Some say its story is bigger than any other Kimuro's, and that it is still waiting to be told.
